Name: Expand menu of Ice Cream Stand
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
Expand Menu of Ice Cream stand.  Despite it being hard to find someone who doesn't like ice cream there are a few NPC's that don't. With that in mind the Ice Cream Stand needs to offer more treats.

This mod adds the following:
Ginger Ale  //Vincent loves.
Cookie //We all know Evelyn makes cookies and with Alex running the Ice Cream Stand; of course he will sell them.
Chocolate Cake // Evelyn loves.
Coffee //Some days you just need coffee.
Milk // Goes with desserts.
Pink Cake // Loved by Haley, Jas, Marine and Vincent.
JoJa Cola // Despite the fact no one loves JoJa Cola it gets requested by NPC's a lot.

Includes optional dialogue for Alex, Evelyn and George. Evelyn makes treats to sell at the Ice Cream Stand. I have removed George's homophobic dialogue. He now wants you to visit more and enjoy dessert together.
